heading: 2.4 Compile-time only
text:
### 2.4 Compile-time only [LUNI.2.4]

`Rational` is a compile-time constant type. Rational literals in rule expressions promote to `Float` at runtime. The
compiler folds all Rational arithmetic before code generation, exactly: at compile
time a Rational's numerator and denominator are integers of any size. What becomes
of a constant that a runtime value cannot hold is [LUNI.2.4.1]'s.
